A fragment anchor link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>Jump to <a href="#section">section</a> below.</p>'
    options = ConversionOptions(extract_metadata=True)
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result)

main()
```
